entities.name: confidence-clustering-issue
observations: Primary blocker for 1.0.0 release
Composite confidence scores cluster tightly (85.5%, 81.2%, 80.8%, 80.8%, 80.3%)
Top 5 candidates all show 80-85% making it impossible to differentiate
Confirmed with real production data from session 177cf025-f0bc-4fba-9838-b395e5cee5b7
Query was 'A tall iron tower that sparkles at night in Paris'
Root cause: cosine similarity on embeddings naturally produces clustered scores (0.78-0.85 range)
Current formula: composite_confidence = semantic_similarity * 0.95 + spatial_confidence * 0.05

entities.name: percentile-normalization-solution
observations: Applies percentile ranking to amplify small differences in raw scores
Formula: confidence = 0.95 - ((rank - 1) / (total - 1)) * 0.80
Transforms clustered scores (85%, 81%, 80%, 80%, 80%) to spread (95%, 86%, 77%, 68%, 59%)
Implementation in frontend game store, not database
Database keeps raw composite_confidence for learning/logic
Frontend computes normalizedTopCandidates for display only
Results in better badge distribution: 2 green (≥80%), 4 yellow (50-80%), 4 gray (<50%)
Successfully tested with real production data from session 177cf025-f0bc-4fba-9838-b395e5cee5b7
Badge distribution improved: Before (5 HIGH, 0 MED, 5 LOW) → After (2 HIGH, 4 MED, 4 LOW)
Database test file created: supabase/tests/test_confidence_scores.sql
Tests verify clustering problem and normalization solution with 10 test scenarios
Edge cases tested: single candidate (95%), 3 candidates (95%, 55%, 15%), 10+ candidates (linear spread)
